nodes.name: TRIGGER
nodes.notes:
It will be triggered when the user clicks the Monitor button on the /task-monitoring page of the n8n webhook website.

DO NOT CHANGE THE PATH: cm-task-monitoring

parameters.content:
## CM Task Monitoring

**Purpose:**
- The purpose of this workflow is to retrieve all tasks from each Microsoft To Do list for every member.

## Important URL
**Website URL**:
https://neightn-booking.indie-demo.com/task-monitoring

**Webhook URL testing**:
https://neightn.indie-demo.com/webhook-test/cm-task-monitoring

**Webhook URL Production**:
https://neightn.indie-demo.com/webhook/cm-task-monitoring

## Documentation
- This workflow is triggered when the user clicks the Monitor button on the /ms-todo/task-monitoring page.

- Retrieve each user's Microsoft To Do lists.

- Retrieve all tasks under each list.

- Send the retrieved data to the react app for display.

**Important Notes:**

- Ignore any lists that do not contain any tasks

- Ignore any tasks that were not created in the current year

nodes.name: ABDUL: HAS TASK VERIFICATION
nodes.notes:
How it works:

1. Grabs all incoming items.
2. Checks if any item has has_task_in_list: true.
3. If yes → keeps only the true items, drops the false ones, and tags each with has_task_in_list_verification: true.
4. If no (all false) → keeps all items as-is and tags each with has_task_in_list_verification: false.
